resources.string: Triage reads your issues straight from your Sentry server. Nothing goes through our servers.
On the token page, create a Personal Token with: Organization Read, Project Read, Issue & Event Read & Write, Member Read.
Triage is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sentry or Functional Software, Inc.
That\'s an organization token. Create a Personal Token instead.
Sentry rejected this token. Check it\'s copied in full and belongs to this server.
This token is missing permissions. Create a new one with the permissions listed above.
This account isn\'t a member of any organization.
Sentry is rate limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
Couldn\'t reach the server. Check your connection and the server URL.
